name: What are the main benefits of converting to an open-floor plan?

mainEntity.name: What are the main benefits of converting to an open-floor plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Converting to an open-floor plan offers several key benefits. It significantly increases the perception of space and allows more natural light to penetrate deeper into the home. This layout promotes better social interaction, as occupants can easily communicate between areas like the kitchen and living room. It also provides greater flexibility in furniture arrangement and decor, making the home feel more modern and versatile.
acceptedAnswer.description: Benefits include increased space perception, more natural light, improved social interaction, and greater design flexibility.
